title: Tie patch test: two blocks with non-matching meshes tied together in uniaxial tension
source: The patch test for mesh tying: a tie across non-matching meshes must transmit a constant stress exactly; B. I. Wohlmuth, A mortar finite element method using dual spaces for the Lagrange multiplier, SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 38(3):989–1012, 2000; M. A. Puso, A 3D mortar method for solid mechanics, IJNME 59:315–336, 2004. Uniaxial stress between frictionless symmetry planes is uniform in both blocks

quantities.reason: uniaxial stress E ε = 1000 × 0.01 is the exact discrete solution: the dual mortar conditions hold for the linear field on both meshes
